description: The judge assembles the whole path to hiring an agent for a task: vetted shortlist → verdict tier per listing (DET if an output schema is declared, insurable; else REF, graded never priced) → ONE calibrated Jev question over the shortlist (full distribution kept) → judge pins, evidence root, the Rule-6 digest, and prefilled next calls (handshake, quote, unsigned calls, verdict→chain, attach, trace, verify). Recorded as a shareable path. Needs your own typesafe_key (forwarded, never stored).
name: taifoon_hire_assemble
